第一章血尽冰湖
一九五零年十一月，长津湖畔，冰雪如刀。
杨思纯衣着单薄的趴在被炮火翻过无数遍的冻土上，手指已经快和枪托冻在一起。远处美军的照明弹把夜空撕成碎片，雪花在燃烧的天空中变成血红色。
“连长！右翼三排联系不上，可能顶不住了！”
通信员的声音嘶哑得几乎听不清。杨思纯吐出白雾，眯眼看向右侧山头。三排阵地上的枪声确实稀疏了不少。
“二班，跟我上！”他抓起***，翻身跃出战壕。
冰雪灌进衣领的刺痛早已麻木，杨思纯唯一能感觉到的是胸腔里那团火——那团保家卫国的烈火。他带着六名战士匍匐前进，子弹在头顶呼啸而过，掀起的冻土碎块砸在钢盔上叮当作响。
“手榴弹准备！”
七枚手榴弹同时飞向美军机枪阵地。爆炸的瞬间，杨思纯率先冲了上去，***喷出愤怒的火舌。子弹击中肉体的闷响、惨叫、金属撞击声，合着血肉飞溅的惨景，仿如地狱般凄厉。就在这时，一声尖啸划破空气。
“炮击——”
杨思纯下意识将身边的新兵小刘扑倒。世界在巨响中碎裂，泥土、冰雪和金属碎片如雨点般砸下。剧痛从右肩蔓延开来，温热的液体浸透了棉衣。
“连长，你受伤了！”
杨思纯咬牙撕开衣服，弹片深深嵌入肩膀。小刘拿出一个止血包压在杨的肩上，杨咬牙道：“没事，继续推进！”他们重新组织进攻，一步步推进，但杨思纯能感觉到力量正随着血液流逝，视线开始模糊。当他尽力再次站起来准备冲锋时，一枚手榴弹在不远处炸开。气浪将他整个人掀翻，他勉强站起，却踉跄着支撑不住，头一栽，人滚下了悬崖，耳边传来惊呼：连长．．
下方是长津湖结冰的湖面。
冰层在撞击下碎裂，刺骨的湖水瞬间吞没了杨思纯。黑暗、寒冷、寂静——与地面上的枪炮轰鸣形成诡异对比。他受伤的身体已不听使唤，只能任凭自己沉向湖底深渊。他意识逐渐消失了。一切都已经平静，微光在深水中弥漫。
---
湖底并非全然黑暗。奇异的水生植物散发着幽蓝光芒，照亮了沉没的树木和岩石。杨思纯的身体缓缓下沉，最终落在一处柔软的泥沙上。
光芒越来越近。
那是一条巨大的鲤鱼，足有三个成年人体长，鳞片在幽蓝水光中泛着金色与银白交织的波纹。最奇异的是它的眼睛——散发着幽幽的淡蓝色光芒。鲤鱼绕着杨思纯游了几圈，然后，它轻轻用头推了推杨思纯的身体，这个年轻人虽气息全无但全身却有股凛冽的寒意，触碰之下鲤鱼都不禁颤抖起来，它激动的挺立身子，望向杨的眼光中充满了欣喜，它开口说道：终于守到你了。言毕鲤鱼张口吐出一颗晶莹剔透的珠子，珠子里七彩光华流转，随后珠子缓缓飞向杨思纯的额头，在接触皮肤的瞬间，杨思纯的身体被柔和的光芒包裹。他身体被一个巨大的冰珠包裹起来，鲤鱼的身影开始变得透明。“六十年...”一个温柔的女声直接在杨思纯的意识中响起，“用我的魂魄，换你生机。六十年后，当首尔的汉江重新映照满月，你将带着水之恩赐重生...”鲤鱼完全化作光点，融入那颗珠子，最后在杨思纯额头上幻化成一个淡金色鲤鱼印记。少顷那印记隐没于皮肤之中，湖底也重归寂静，只留下被柔和光芒和冰珠包裹的志愿军战士，如同沉睡在时间的琥珀中。

第二章复活
六十年后。
首尔，汉江公园。
夜，深夜，极深。月，圆月，极圆。月光洒在江面上，碎成万点银光。一位年轻男子从江水中走出，浑身破军装湿透却毫不在意。他看起来二十多岁，瘦高身材，面容坚毅，英气逼人，手上还带着黑色的硝灰。
杨思纯低头看着自己完好无损的双手，又摸了摸光滑肩膀——那是曾经嵌入弹片的地方，记忆如潮水般涌回：战场、炮声、冰湖、战士肝胆俱裂的惊呼，鲤鱼的光...以及那个温柔的声音。
“六十年...”他喃喃自语。
适应现代世界只花了他整整一天，他奇迹般拥有精通韩文英文的能力，通过路边的报纸、电视展示窗和垃圾桶里的杂志，他很快地拼凑出这个陌生时代：高楼大厦、飞驰的汽车、人人手中都有的发光小盒子...
更重要的是，他发现了自己身上的变化。
杨思纯能够感知到水中的一切。当他站在汉江边，闭上眼，整个江流的脉络都清晰呈现在脑海中——哪里鱼群聚集，哪里水底有沉没物，甚至能感觉到水中微弱的能量流动。他发现自己能控制水。最初只是让杯中的水微微晃动，一小时后已经能在江面上聚起小小的水龙卷。又只用了半小时他居然能让江水卷起层层细浪，他似鱼般（只能说比鱼还要鱼）滑入水中捕捉鱼群，找到沉在江底的金属和遗失物，卖给附近的废品收购站换钱。半夜，他会在桥洞下提炼一种奇异的物质——那是他从水中提取出的灵气结晶。
过程很简单却需要极大耐心：他盘膝坐在桥洞下，双手虚按水面，将精神力注入水中，感知并吸收那些微小的灵气粒子。渐渐地，水面上会浮现出极细的、几乎看不见的光点。他用意念将这些光点聚拢，压缩，经过数小时甚至一整夜的努力，才能得到一颗米粒大小的类透明晶体。
杨思纯称之为“水精石”。
就在重生后的第二个月，他第一次使用了水精石。那天晚上，他在提炼过程中感到疲惫，于是将刚成形的水精石握在手中。一股清凉的能量顺着手臂流入体内，疲惫一扫而空，连带着对水的感知都变得更加敏锐。
从那天起，他每晚都会提炼水精石，一部分用于自身修炼，一部分存起来。他能感觉到，随着水精石的积累，自己控制水流的能力越来越强，甚至开始能够感知到水中的“记忆”——某个地方曾经发生过的强烈情感波动会以某种方式留在水中，他能隐约捕捉到这些片段。
一个月后的雨夜．．
---
江南区一条小巷里，金永珍拼命奔跑，高跟鞋早已不知甩到哪里，光着的脚被粗糙的地面磨破。身后，三个醉醺醺的男人紧追不舍。她刚刚加班完回家路上却被三个醉汉盯上。

Chapter 1 Blood drains the ice lake
In November 1950, by the Changjin Lake, the ice and snow were as sharp as knives.
Yang Sichun was lying on the frozen soil that had been turned over countless times by artillery fire, wearing only thin clothes. His fingers were almost frozen with the butt of his gun. The American military flares in the distance tore the night sky into pieces, and the snowflakes turned blood red in the burning sky.
"Company Commander! We can't contact the third platoon on the right wing and may not be able to withstand it!"
The correspondent's voice was so hoarse that it was almost inaudible. Yang Sichun breathed out white mist and squinted at the mountain on the right. The gunfire on the third row of positions was indeed much sparser.
"Class 2, follow me!" He grabbed the gun, turned over and jumped out of the trench.
The stinging pain from the ice and snow pouring into his collar has long been numb. The only thing Yang Sichun can feel is the fire in his chest - the fire that protects his family and country. He crawled forward with six soldiers, bullets whizzing past his head, and the pieces of frozen soil thrown up clinked on the helmets.
"Grenade ready!"
Seven grenades flew towards the US machine gun position at the same time. At the moment of the explosion, Yang Sichun rushed forward first, his gun spitting out tongues of angry fire. The muffled sound of the bullet hitting the flesh, the scream, and the sound of metal hitting metal, combined with the tragic scene of blood and flesh splattering, were as miserable as hell. Just then, a scream pierced the air.
"Bombardment——"
Yang Sichun subconsciously knocked down the recruit Xiao Liu next to him. The world shattered with a loud bang, as mud, ice, snow, and metal shards rained down. Severe pain spread from his right shoulder, and warm liquid soaked into his cotton clothes.
"Company commander, you are injured!"
Yang Sichun gritted his teeth and tore open his clothes, and the shrapnel was deeply embedded in his shoulder. Xiao Liu took out a hemostatic pack and pressed it on Yang's shoulder. Yang gritted his teeth and said, "It's okay, keep pushing forward!" They reorganized their attack and pushed forward step by step, but Yang Sichun could feel the power draining away with the blood, and his vision began to blur. When he tried his best to stand up again and prepare to charge, a grenade exploded not far away. The air wave overturned his whole body. He managed to stand up, but he staggered and couldn't hold on. His head fell and he rolled down the cliff. An exclamation came from his ears: Company commander. ．
Below is the frozen surface of Changjin Lake.
The ice shattered under the impact, and the biting lake water swallowed Yang Sichun instantly. Dark, cold, silent - an eerie contrast to the roar of guns on the ground. His injured body no longer obeyed, and he could only let himself sink into the abyss of the lake. He gradually lost consciousness. Everything had calmed down, and a faint light filled the deep water.
---
The bottom of the lake is not completely dark. Strange aquatic plants emit a faint blue light that illuminates sunken trees and rocks. Yang Sichun's body slowly sank, and finally landed on a soft sand.
The light is getting closer.
It was a huge carp, as long as three adults, and its scales were rippled with gold and silver in the blue water. The strangest thing is its eyes - emitting a faint light blue light. The carp swam around Yang Sichun a few times, and then it gently pushed Yang Sichun's body with its head. Although the young man had no breath, there was a biting chill all over his body. The carp couldn't help but tremble under the touch. It stood up excitedly and looked at Yang with eyes full of joy. It said: I finally got you. After speaking, the carp opened its mouth and spat out a crystal clear bead. The colorful brilliance flowed in the bead, and then the bead slowly flew to Yang Sichun's forehead. The moment it touched the skin, Yang Sichun's body was wrapped in soft light. His body was wrapped in a huge ice bead, and the carp's figure began to become transparent. "Sixty years..." A gentle female voice sounded directly in Yang Sichun's consciousness, "I will give you life with my soul. Sixty years later, when the Han River in Seoul reflects the full moon again, you will be reborn with the gift of water..." The carp completely turned into a point of light, integrated into the bead, and finally transformed into a pale golden carp mark on Yang Sichun's forehead. After a while, the mark disappeared into the skin, and the lakeSilence also returned to the bottom, leaving only the volunteer soldiers wrapped in soft light and ice beads, as if sleeping in the amber of time.
Chapter 2 Resurrection
Sixty years later.
Seoul, Han River Park.
Night, late at night, very deep. Moon, full moon, extremely round. The moonlight shines on the river, breaking into thousands of silver points. A young man walked out of the river. He was soaked in a torn military uniform but didn't care. He looked to be in his twenties, tall and thin, with a resolute face and a heroic spirit. He also had black gunpowder on his hands.
Yang Sichun looked down at his intact hands, and touched his smooth shoulder - the place where the shrapnel had been embedded. Memories came back like a flood: the battlefield, the sound of artillery, the ice lake, the soldiers' liver-gallbladder-breaking screams, the light of the carp... and that gentle voice.
"Sixty years..." he muttered.
It only took him a whole day to adapt to the modern world. He miraculously possesses the ability to be proficient in Korean and English. Through newspapers on the roadside, TV display windows and magazines in trash cans, he quickly pieced together this strange era: high-rise buildings, speeding cars, small luminous boxes in everyone's hands...
More importantly, he noticed changes in himself.
Yang Sichun can sense everything in the water. When he stood on the bank of the Han River and closed his eyes, the entire river flow was clearly presented in his mind - where fish gathered, where there were sunken objects at the bottom, and he could even feel the weak flow of energy in the water. He discovered that he could control water. At first, the water in the cup was just shaking slightly, but after an hour, small waterspouts were forming on the river surface. It only took him half an hour to actually make the river water roll up waves. He slid into the water like a fish (it can only be said to be more fishy than a fish), caught fish, found metal and lost objects sunk at the bottom of the river, and sold them to a nearby scrap collection station for money. In the middle of the night, he would refine a strange substance under the bridge - it was the spiritual energy crystal he extracted from the water.
The process is simple but requires a lot of patience: He sits cross-legged under the bridge, presses his hands on the water surface, injects spiritual power into the water, and senses and absorbs those tiny spiritual energy particles. Gradually, tiny, almost invisible points of light will appear on the water. He used his mind to gather and compress these light points, and after hours or even a whole night of hard work, he was able to obtain a quasi-transparent crystal the size of a rice grain.
Yang Sichun called it "water essence stone".
Just in the second month after his rebirth, he used the Water Essence Stone for the first time. That night, he felt tired during the refining process, so he held the newly formed water essence stone in his hands. A cool energy flows into the body along the arms, fatigue is swept away, and the perception of water becomes more acute.
From that day on, he would refine water essence stones every night, part of which would be used for his own cultivation and part of which he would save. He could feel that with the accumulation of water essence stones, his ability to control the water flow became stronger and stronger, and he even began to be able to perceive "memories" in the water - strong emotional fluctuations that had occurred somewhere would remain in the water in some way, and he could vaguely capture these fragments.
A rainy night a month later. ．
---
In an alley in Jiangnan District, Jin Yongzhen ran as hard as she could. Her high heels had been thrown to nowhere, and her bare feet were worn out by the rough ground. Behind him, three drunken men were chasing after him. She had just been walking home from overtime work when she was stared at by three drunk men.
